name: HealthScoreDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/HealthScoreDashboard
summary: A health score dashboard: how well something performs for the people who use it, read as one score out of 100 and its bands. A page heading with the period Select sits over the overall score, a ChartCard with the figure, its band Tag (Good at 80 or more, Fair from 50 to 79, Poor under 50), the top cause of poor samples and a Line Chart of the score per hour. Two ChartCards rank the score per application and per location in a BarList, lowest first, each row naming its top cause. An hourly score card gives every application a Tracker strip, one block per hour colored by band, with its current band Tag at the end of the row. Under the grid, a Card lists the open incidents as Item rows: what is affected, the cause, how many devices and what share of samples, when it opened, and its band. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the period loads, the chart, the rankings and the trackers render their own Skeleton and the incidents hold Skeleton rows, so the page does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A period with no samples. The score shows a dash with no band, and every region keeps its box with an empty state that names the period and says what fills it.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The request for the period failed: the score shows a dash, and every card keeps its header with a danger Alert that names what did not load and offers Retry.
